title: Whole-mount immunofluorescence staining of blood and lymphatic vessels in murine small intestine
author: Paavonsalo, Subashi, et al.

steps.title: Permeabilize tissue with PBST
steps.instruction: Remove PBS and wash the small‑intestine sample with 0.3 % PBST at 20 °C–25 °C on a rotator for four cycles of 30 min each.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.3 % PBST and rotate at 20 °C–25 °C for 30 min; repeat 4 times.

steps.title: Block sample in DIM
steps.instruction: Remove the 0.3 % PBST and incubate the sample in DIM at 20 °C–25 °C with rotation for 1 h (blocking time must not be shorter than 1 h).

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Remove DIM and incubate the sample in primary antibodies (goat anti‑podocalyxin 1:400 and rabbit anti‑LYVE1 1:600) diluted in DIM at 4 °C with rotation for 2 days; this is a pause point.

steps.title: Wash primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Remove the primary‑antibody mix and wash the sample with 0.3 % PBST at 20 °C–25 °C on a rotator for approximately 6 h, changing the solution at least five times.

steps.title: Prepare and incubate secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the secondary antibodies (donkey anti‑goat Alexa Fluor™ Plus 488 1:1000 and donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor™ Plus 594 1:1000) at ≥17 000 g for 5 min at 20 °C–25 °C, keep the supernatant, then incubate the sample in this antibody solution diluted in PBS at 4 °C for 16–24 h with rotation, protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge secondary antibodies at ≥17 000 g for 5 min at 20 °C–25 °C; use the supernatant.
Incubate the sample in the diluted secondary‑antibody mix at 4 °C with rotation for 16–24 h, protecting from light.

steps.title: Wash secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Remove the secondary‑antibody mix and wash the sample with PBS at 20 °C–25 °C on a rotator for approximately 6 h, changing the solution at least five times.

steps.title: Post‑fix with PFA
steps.instruction: Working in a fume hood, remove PBS and post‑fix the sample with 1 % PFA at 20 °C–25 °C on a rotator for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 % PFA and rotate at 20 °C–25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash post‑fixation
steps.instruction: Working in a fume hood, remove PFA and wash the sample with PBS at 20 °C–25 °C on a rotator for two washes of 15 min each.

substeps.instruction: Wash with PBS, rotating at 20 °C–25 °C for 15 min; repeat once.

steps.title: Store sample before mounting
steps.instruction: The post‑fixed tissue can be stored in PBS at 4 °C for up to 7 days before mounting.
